item.title: Eigenvectors — which directions does a matrix preserve?
item.description: Suppose a two-neuron linear layer takes an input $v$ and returns $Av$ . You already know how to compute the output for one input. Can you find two inputs whose behavior tells you what happens to every input?

item.title: SVD — how much does a rectangular matrix stretch each direction?
item.description: A neural network weight matrix can map 32 input features to 96 outputs. Asking whether its output points along its input makes little sense when the two live in different spaces. We can still ask a concrete question. Among unit-length inputs, which one produces the longest output?

item.title: PCA — which line best represents a cloud of points?
item.description: Imagine you can store only one number per observation with two features. You get to choose a common reference point and a line through it. For each observation you store its signed distance along the line. Which line lets you reconstruct the original points with the least total squared error?
